name: reveal3-animation
title: Reveal 3 Animation
description: The only one masked by a path rather than a circle: a flat line splits into a lens as the two quadratic control points pull apart to 800 and -200. The two words start centred on a full screen, then FLIP into the layout below as the mask opens under them — one scrubbed timeline drives the title move, the mask and the image together. One of seven on-scroll SVG filter reveals from Codrops' OnScrollFilter (MIT, Codrops), split into a component per reveal.
